experience.title: Full Stack Developer

Migrated a client application from traditional server hosting to Cloudflare Workers, reducing cold-start latency from **2+ seconds to under 100ms**.

experience.title: Software Engineer Intern

Diagnosed and resolved a frontend performance issue by fixing missing Redux selectors, eliminating redundant network calls on route changes.
Contributed to code quality through small, reviewable pull requests and participated in **Agile Practices** including two-week sprint retrospectives using Jira.

projects.name: Resume AI
bullets: Built an AI-powered resume builder that generates tailored resumes and calculates an ATS keyword-matching score with auto-rewrite functionality.
Implemented a retrieval-augmented generation system in **FastAPI** using TF-IDF vectorization to pull relevant HR guidelines before generating content.
Reduced generation time from **75s to under 30s** by parallelizing independent tasks with Python thread pools; integrated **JWT** auth and SQLAlchemy for user persistence.
Deployed frontend to Vercel and backend to **AWS EC2** inside **Docker** with configured volumes, environment secrets, and CORS headers.

projects.name: Notes App
bullets: Built a full-stack note-taking application from scratch to understand the complete request lifecycle without starter templates.
Implemented **JWT** authentication on **Express.js**, **MongoDB** storage, and **React JS**/**Redux** state management on the frontend.
Designed server-side search with chained Mongoose filters and optimized sort order for note pinning across both backend queries and Redux state.
